purpose: Machine-readable registry for nest console tag routing and future writable scene objects.
coreRule: No tag, no text route. One tag, one destination family. Every writable object must have a tag registry entry before it is connected to the nest console.
tagNamingRule: Use scene path plus surface type for new complex or nested surfaces. A tag must not use only a generic state name such as lapClose. If a scene has multiple text surfaces, include the surface type such as Bubble, Note, Caption, or Hint.

hubbyNote.writeSurface: home powder notebook / 猫窝留言
hubbyNote.notes: This is the default destination when the user says 写猫窝留言 without naming a specific bubble or panel.

useFor: Alex short rotating speech in coffeeCorner
coffeeCorner.notes: Legacy simple tag is kept because coffeeCorner currently means the main coffeeCorner bubble by convention. New nested surfaces must use fuller scene-path tags.

windowWeather.writeSurface: home weather window / 窗边叮嘱
useFor: weather note under the home window
windowWeather.notes: Home weather belongs to home. Do not route or name it under coffeeCorner.

coffeeCornerLapCloseBubble.writeSurface: coffeeCorner lapClose child-scene bubble / 坐腿图气泡
useFor: coffeeCorner lap-close child scene speech bubble
sitting-on-lap close scene line under coffeeCorner
隔壁一句：写猫窝所有地方时必须 include this target
coffeeCornerLapCloseBubble.notes: Canonical tag includes parent scene, child scene, and surface type. Existing console tag [coffeeCornerLapClose] can remain as backward-compatible alias. Generic [lapCloseBubble] is deprecated because other scenes may later have their own lapClose bubble.

useFor: future short mood note if UI is active
moodNote.notes: Do not use until the current UI has an active moodNote target.

writeAllPlacesPreset.name: allKnownWritablePlaces
writeAllPlacesPreset.description: Use when the user says 写猫窝所有地方 / write all nest places.
writeAllPlacesPreset.rule: If a canonical tag is not yet supported by the live console, use the registered alias and do not claim canonical support until the parser route is safety-tested and promoted.

newWritableObjectChecklist: Assign ownerScene and parentScene when nested.
Assign exactly one canonical tag using scene path plus surface type when needed.
Add aliases only for backward compatibility.
Add the object to scene manifest / owner registry.
Only then connect it to the nest console.
Safety-test the console before promotion if runtime parsing or publishing changes.
antiPatterns: one tag writes to unrelated destinations
using [lapCloseBubble] as canonical without parent scene
adding writable UI without tag registry
promoting console changes without a safety test
